_approach: The 'filtered disco loop' school: a punchy 4/4 kick, an open hat on every offbeat 8th, and a flammed clap (a soft grace note just ahead of the main hit, mimicking the layered-clap flam nu-disco producers use) rather than a single clean transient. Tighter swing than the jazz-house patterns -- 55% MPC (engine 0.10). Reference: Purple Disco Machine 'Hypnotized'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
